summary.finalText:
Created `hidden/`, `run-hidden.mjs`, `rubric.md`, `VALIDATION.md`, and final `MANIFEST.json`. Private reference and validation artifacts remain in `scratch/`; `base/` is unchanged.

**16 counted tests:** ORDER 3, LOTS 1, IDEM 2, RACE 2, REVERSAL 2, AUTH 2, PENDING 2, CLOCK 2. Plus one non-counting store-efficiency measurement.

**Validation:** base 0/16; reference 16/16 and original tests 9/9. All 14 faulty variants detected, including import failure without runner crash. Renamed quote fields and system-clock-only implementations pass.
bashCommands: pwd && ls -la && find base -type f | sort

node run-hidden.mjs base scratch/validation/base && node run-hidden.mjs scratch/reference scratch/validation/reference && node scratch/validate-variants.mjs && cp -R scratch/reference scratch/direct && cp -R hidden scratch/direct/evaluator-hidden && (cd scratch/direct && node --test "evaluator-hidden/*.test.ts")

find . -path './scratch' -prune -o -path './base' -prune -o -type f -print | sort && node --test "scratch/reference/tests/**/*.test.ts" > scratch/validation/reference-original.log 2>&1 && node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFile} from "node:fs/promises"; const r=JSON.parse(await readFile("scratch/validation/reference/hidden-result.json","utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({summary:r.summary,traps:r.traps},null,2));'

node run-hidden.mjs base scratch/validation/base && node run-hidden.mjs scratch/reference scratch/validation/reference && node scratch/validate-variants.mjs && cp -R hidden/. scratch/direct/evaluator-hidden/ && (cd scratch/direct && node --test "evaluator-hidden/*.test.ts") > scratch/validation/direct.log 2>&1
